svg.title: Covered Call Optimizer — AWS deployment and email sign-in
svg.desc: Route 53 maps aimoney.kodekomplete.com to an Elastic IP on one EC2 instance. Caddy terminates HTTPS. React and FastAPI run in an application container. PostgreSQL holds portfolio records, manually authorized users, hashed email codes and hashed sessions. Amazon SES delivers single-use sign-in codes using a restricted EC2 instance role. Secure cookies remember trusted devices. Questrade, Yahoo Finance and OpenAI remain application integrations. Encrypted EBS persists private files and database volumes. S3 backup automation is future work. PostgreSQL and application ports are not publicly exposed.
svg.text: Oregon us-west-2 · one EC2 instance · three containers · email sign-in · October 23, 2026
UI and API share the same HTTPS origin.
Start when needed · Docker Compose restarts containers on boot
TLS certificate + renewal · HTTP redirects to HTTPS
Image: caddy:2 Container / service: caddy Public ports: 80, 443
Email codes · records · broker access · assessments
Pricing / simulation · no network or database access
postgres_data: database data/ + reports/: holdings and captures
.secrets/: credentials Caddy volumes: certificates and configuration
Retained when EC2 stops · container replacement does not delete records
Solid boundaries: deployed components. Dashed S3 box: future backup automation. No public registration or per-user portfolios.
Purple dashed arrows: DNS lookup. Grey arrows: runtime traffic / persistence; dashed grey: deployment or backup transfer.
Future: automated backups + restore drills, then audit and roles; per-user data isolation requires a separate schema/API migration.
